Name: Wooper and Clodsire as Farm Animals
Author: DGlaky
Description:
Adds Wooper and Clodsire as farm animals. Players can purchase a Clodsire for their barns from Marnie for 10000g. After 8 days as a Wooper, it will evolve into a Clodsire and begin to leave behind Wooper Slime and dig up Everstones. Both of these items are found in the same way a pig finds truffles. 5 Wooper Slimes can be placed into a Slime Egg-Press to get a random Slime Egg. The Everstone can be traded to the desert trader for a Wooper Egg, which can be hatched in a coop. These Wooper are holding everstones, and as a result will never evolve into Clodsire. They will also leave behind Wooper Slime and can dig up Nuggets, which can be sold for a high price.

﻿There is an optional file that adds the shiny and Johtonian variants of Wooper and the shiny variant of Clodsire using the Alternative Textures mod.
